stem: With Robert Lowell’s death, poetry appears to have shrunk from the ground he commandeered: his grand conception of the port as public conscience has ____ in the present era of notably small and private poems.
optsZh: 激起了毫无保留的热情
几乎没有获得支持或进展

stem: Her lecture was entertaining though unoriginal: she hoped that by (i)____ her audience, she could (ii)____ the hackneyed observations on which her argument depended.

Around the early 1980s, technology companies began creating the first portable machines that resemble today’s laptop computers. Still, for many years, large and bulky desktop computers (i)____ the market, because you always had to (ii)____ something for portability. Compared with laptops, desktops had more power, bigger screens, more comfortable keyboards, and more storage space.
colsZh: 在……中几乎没有容身之地

stem: Many people fail to (i)____ memoirs and novels, a tendency arguably (ii)____ by discussions of the "graphic novel": that term is applied to any narrative drawn in the manner of a comic book, even ones like Marjane Satrapi's Persepolis, which (iii)____.
colsZh: 预料到的；提前采取行动的
被描绘的；被明确勾勒的

stem: The mayor’s hunger for power was ____: in her own heart, she was utterly convinced that all her energies were being poured out in the service of a cause greater than herself.
optsZh: 未被承认的；未被意识到的

items.answerReviewReason: 校对认为配套答案不可靠
items.explanation: 配套答案为 C/F（logical / understandable）。冒号后说她打心底认定自己是在为更大的事业付出，说明她并不承认、也意识不到自己的权力欲，更合理的是 B/E（unacknowledged / subconscious）。

stem: Psychoanalysis has increasingly immured itself behind high walls of jargon by using terms like “introjective identification” and “countercathexis” and this emphasis on ____ is in part an effort to preserve the field’s waning mystique.
optsZh: 不透明，半透明；晦涩，难解

stem: Velazquez’ painting can be somewhat ____: one cannot get on familiar terms with them, but only admire their colorful polish from afar.
